questions.question: Ravinder is the father of a girl, Mahi. Mahi has a younger brother, Tej. Identify Ravinder’s relationship to Tej.
questions.explanation: Mahi and Tej are siblings, so their father is Ravinder.

questions.question: At a Ludhiana exhibition, a woman, Harleen, points to a boy: “His mother is my father’s younger sister.” Which description fits the boy?
questions.explanation: The boy’s mother is Harleen’s paternal aunt; he is her paternal-aunt’s son.

questions.question: In a code, X @ Y means X is Y’s mother, and X # Y means X is Y’s brother. In L @ M # N, what is L to N?
questions.explanation: L is M’s mother, and M and N are siblings; therefore L is N’s mother.

questions.question: Gurpreet is a man whose wife is Jasleen. Jasleen’s younger brother is Arjun. What is Arjun’s relationship to Gurpreet?
questions.explanation: Arjun is the brother of Gurpreet’s wife, so he is Gurpreet’s brother-in-law through his wife.

questions.question: Seven relatives are Baldev, Rani, Karan, Neha, Pooja, Aman and Tara. Baldev is Rani’s husband. Neha is their daughter and Aman’s paternal aunt. Pooja is Baldev’s daughter-in-law and Tara is Neha’s daughter. Karan is Aman’s father. There are exactly two married couples, and all named parents of a child are married. Which pair consists of first cousins?
questions.explanation: Neha is the sister of Aman’s father Karan; her daughter Tara and Aman are first cousins.

questions.question: P is the parent of Q. Q is the mother of a girl, R. Which fact about P follows with certainty?
questions.explanation: The route from R is mother Q, then Q’s parent P; P’s gender is unspecified.

questions.question: Code: X + Y means X is Y’s father; X - Y means X is Y’s sister; X / Y means X is Y’s mother. Which expression makes A the maternal aunt of D’s father?
questions.explanation: D’s father is C; C’s mother is B, whose sister is A.

questions.question: A girl, Diya, is the daughter of Sonal’s brother. Choose the precise relationship of Diya to Sonal, a woman.
questions.explanation: The middle link is Sonal’s brother; his daughter is Sonal’s niece through her brother.

questions.question: A family tree is described in words: Mohan (male) and Usha (female) are married. Their children are Dev (male) and Leena (female). Dev and Asha (female) have a daughter, Pari. Who is Pari’s paternal grandmother?
questions.explanation: Pari’s father is Dev, and Dev’s mother is Usha.

questions.question: Nitin, a man, introduces an elderly woman: “She is the mother of my mother’s only daughter.” What should Nitin call her?
questions.explanation: Nitin’s mother’s only daughter is his sister; that sister’s mother is Nitin’s own mother.

questions.question: Question: Is A the maternal aunt of boy D? I. A is sister of B; B is a parent of C; C is D’s father. II. B is female. Do these statements settle the question, whether the answer is yes or no?

options.label: B
options.text: Even together they do not settle it

questions.explanation: I places A two generations above D on his father’s side, so she is not his maternal aunt; B’s gender is unnecessary.

questions.question: Meera’s husband is the only son of Kamla, a woman. Kamla’s daughter Kavita has a son, Rohit. Select Rohit’s relationship to Meera’s husband.
questions.explanation: Kavita is Meera’s husband’s sister, so Kavita’s son is his nephew through his sister.

questions.question: The code X * Y means X is Y’s wife, X % Y means X is Y’s father, and X & Y means X is Y’s daughter. Decode P * Q % R & P. Which person is certainly R’s mother?
questions.explanation: R is P’s daughter, and P is female because P is Q’s wife; P is R’s mother.

questions.question: At a family meal, a woman attends with her daughter and that daughter’s daughter. Counting only these three, how many are daughters of another person present?
questions.explanation: The middle woman is the eldest woman’s daughter, and the youngest is the middle woman’s daughter.

questions.question: Aman’s father has a younger brother, Hardeep. Hardeep’s wife is Rupinder. Which relation connects Rupinder to Aman?
questions.explanation: Hardeep is Aman’s paternal uncle, younger than his father; Hardeep’s wife is his paternal aunt by marriage.

questions.question: A man, Vikram, points to a woman’s photograph: “Her only daughter’s husband is the father of my wife’s only brother.” Vikram’s wife and her brother have the same parents, who are married. The photographed woman is Vikram’s wife’s _____.
questions.explanation: The daughter’s husband is the wife’s father, so the daughter is the wife’s mother; the photographed woman is her maternal grandmother.

questions.question: X > Y means X is Y’s son; X = Y means X is Y’s wife; X < Y means X is Y’s brother. Which expression proves M is the mother of N’s father?
questions.explanation: P is N’s male parent because P is M’s son; M is P’s female parent because M is Q’s wife.

questions.question: Eight relatives are Iqbal, Farida, Salim, Imran, Nisha, Reena, Zoya and Kabir. Iqbal and Farida are married parents of brothers Salim and Imran. Nisha and Reena are their daughters-in-law. Zoya’s father is Imran; Kabir’s mother is Nisha. Zoya and Kabir are cousins. All children’s parents are named and married. Who is Zoya’s mother?
questions.explanation: Cousins have different fathers here: Kabir’s father is Salim, married to Nisha; Imran’s wife and Zoya’s mother is Reena.

questions.question: A is B’s mother, B is C’s father, and C is D’s mother. Relative to D’s generation, where is A placed?
questions.explanation: From D, move up to C, then B, then A: three parent links.

questions.question: A tree described in words has married parents Ajay (male) and Seema (female), their son Raghav and daughter Anu, Anu’s husband Vikas, and their son Yuvraj. A student writes four labels. Which label reverses the relationship incorrectly?
questions.explanation: Raghav is the brother of Yuvraj’s mother; Yuvraj is Raghav’s sister’s son, not his maternal uncle.

questions.question: A woman, Pritam, has an elder son Jatin and a younger son Naman. Jatin is married to Ritu, and Naman to Simmi. What is Ritu to Simmi?
questions.explanation: Simmi’s husband is Naman; his elder brother Jatin’s wife Ritu is her elder co-sister-in-law.

questions.question: A is B’s brother; B is C’s mother; C is a girl. Conclusion I: A is C’s maternal uncle. Conclusion II: C is A’s sister’s daughter. Choose the valid assessment.
questions.explanation: A is the brother of C’s mother B; conversely C is the daughter of A’s sister.

questions.question: Use X + Y for X is Y’s daughter, X $ Y for X is Y’s husband, and X # Y for X is Y’s sister. In T + U $ V # W, identify T’s father.
questions.explanation: T is U’s daughter, and U is male because U is V’s husband; U is T’s father.

questions.question: The father of a boy, Laksh, is the brother of Rhea’s mother. Rhea is a girl. Which description correctly gives Rhea’s link to Laksh?
questions.explanation: Rhea’s mother is Laksh’s father’s sister, so Rhea is Laksh’s paternal-aunt’s daughter.

questions.question: At an Amritsar wedding, woman Navjot introduces a girl: “Her father is the son of the only daughter of my mother. I am that only daughter, and I have only one son.” Navjot’s son’s wife is the girl’s mother. Which relationship does Navjot have to the girl?
questions.explanation: The only daughter is Navjot, so the girl’s father is Navjot’s son; Navjot is her paternal grandmother.
